title: A Website Opportunities demo build writes every template post from the research (never "Coming soon") on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash, reads a thin website through Jina and Firecrawl by default, keeps promotions off the menu but not serving hours, and a removed site takes its site_brief row
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set, run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-editorial-guide.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-menu-reader.test.mjs packages/wo/website-opportunities/test/domain-website-readers.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/opportunities-menu-parts.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/website-opportunities-research-wiring.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/site-brief-removal.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/wo-agent-demo.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/sweep-resolve.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/site-call.test.mjs packages/tools/tracy-site-tools/test/emdash-call.test.mjs
S2: Read the exit code, the `# pass`, `# fail`, `# skipped` and `# cancelled` lines and the tests named below.
expect: S1 exits 0 with 0 failures, 0 skipped, 0 cancelled.
'build 16: research of 2 old topics for 22 template posts gives 22 written posts, none "Coming soon"' passes: 20 swept posts with distinct titles, no unresolved field, posts-written passes 22 of 22.

'splitTopics: fewer topics than posts are split into narrower ones from the same facts, never invented' and 'composePost: a title, body and excerpt from the facts, never "Coming soon"; a review is not copied' pass.
'website content lists only readers research can run, and defaults to all of them' and 'website content: by default a thin direct crawl falls to Jina, then Firecrawl, each only with its key' pass.

'a promotion is not a dish: happy hour, "x for y", a deal or offer heading, one price for all, in any language' passes, and 'serving hours are not a promotion: "until 14:00", "served 11-15", "from 17:00" keep their dishes' keeps the all-day breakfast, lunch and dinner dishes while dropping happy hour, "gratis", "-30 %", "offert" and "get a dessert free".

'a plan the sweep completes is not refused' passes: validateAgentPlan raises no coverage.posts for a plan writing one post per research topic, and planSweep then writes the two split topics into the posts left, nothing unresolved; 'the sweep writes the topics the agent did not use' passes: drafts are matched to the posts the agent wrote by their words, so no topic is written twice.

'a Joomla or EmDash template post's body is written from the research like WordPress's, else reported' and 'a Joomla or EmDash template post's body: written over the template's own, read this call, never over the agent's' pass; the Joomla and EmDash sweep body-guard tests pass inside withSweepRead and stay BODY_SHRINK outside it or without a read.

'a written post uses only the facts its distinct words say' passes: a post on "fresh bread every morning" leaves "fresh pasta every evening" to the sweep, and a post in other words still uses its fact; 'a Joomla or EmDash template post's body is written…' also empties a Joomla fulltext still the template's under an intro the agent wrote, or reports it when the plan wrote it; 'a post field the agent changed after the sweep planned is kept' passes: every sweep post write (Joomla/EmDash post, WordPress post, plain content.update/content_update) drops a field no longer holding its planned value (`was`).
Each of the four site_brief removal tests passes: Remove, a torn-down site, a forgotten demo, a stale claim.
evidence: The Willow Nook cafe demo, local build 16 (25/10/2026): the research held 2 post topics for 22 template posts, the sweep wrote "Coming soon" into 20 and posts-written failed; the menu page needed Jina but the default order named no reader; the specials line "Happy hour. Two cocktails. 150 kr." was read as a dish; a deleted site's site_brief row refused the next build AGENT_DEMO_OTHER_WRITER (#1749). Review of round 12 (26/10/2026): coverage.posts refused a plan the sweep would complete; Joomla and EmDash posts kept the template body; "All day breakfast until 14:00" was dropped as a promotion; the sweep could write a topic the agent had already written. Second review pass (26/10/2026): a post on one fact used another sharing most of its words, so the sweep drafted nothing; a Joomla fulltext under an intro the agent wrote stayed the template's, unreported; the sweep's title write overwrote a title the agent changed after planning.
fence: Mechanism only, over fixtures and a scratch database. Not covered: a live build on a real site, Joomla and EmDash live runs, the quality of the composed post text, and site_brief rows left behind before this change.
